propositions: The typecheck Makefile target only runs mypy on src/rebar but not on scripts/, leaving 47 script files type-unchecked despite 15 detectable type errors across 6 files
CI workflow invokes scripts/*.py as gate implementations (e.g. check_verify_gate_parity.py) but those scripts are not covered by the type-gating step that enforces the Verified vote

Widen the typecheck target from 'mypy src/rebar' to 'mypy src/rebar scripts' and fix the surfaced type errors at their source rather than suppressing them via per-module overrides or type: ignore comments

Two of the 15 type errors represent latent bugs: capture_jira_fixtures calls .strip() on str | None, and check_complexity_baseline passes a possibly-None dict where dict[str, int] is required due to incomplete None narrowing
